fullContent:
Chaturmukha Rasa 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali 
 Introduction 
 Chaturmukha Rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation in the form of tablets. This medicine consists of heavy metals in a purified form so it should be taken under medical supervision. Chaturmukha Rasa is used to treat anemia, diabetes etc. This formulation balances Vata and Pitta. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Purified mercury 
 Purified sulphur 
 Iron Bhasma 
 Mica Bhasma 
 Castor leaves (Ricinus communis) 
 Aloe Vera juice 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Finely crush all the ingredients with aloe vera juice and make the consistency of a paste and form pills of 125 mg each. Wrap those pills in castor leaves and leave them to dry for three days. Three days later store them in an air tight container. 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet twice a day after meals with honey or Triphala powder. 
 Indications 
 
 Enhances digestion 
 Anemia 
 Diabetes 
 Abdominal colic 
 Asthma 
 Hiccups 
 Gout 
 Hemorrhoids 
 Psychotic disorders 
 Anorexia 
 Heart burn 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Self-medication can prove to be fatal. 
 Over dosage might get poisonous. 
 It should be avoided during pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 It should be consumed under strict medical prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
